_note: Original poems written for Buddy (free to use in this project). Add public-domain rhymes of your own in rhymes_user.json using the same format.

poems.title: Mango Mango
lines: Mango, mango, round and sweet,
yellow and juicy, a summer treat.
I wash my hands, I take a bite,
sticky fingers, what a delight!

poems.title: Little Raindrops
lines: Pitter, patter, raindrops fall,
on the roof and on the wall.
Frogs go hopping, puddles grow,
after rain, a rainbow glow!

poems.title: Hello Moon
lines: Hello moon, so round and bright,
you light the sky up every night.
The stars all twinkle, one, two, three,
and you smile down at little me.

poems.title: Good Morning Sun
lines: Good morning sun, you're warm and gold,
you wake the flowers, young and old.
The birds all sing, the sky is blue,
a brand new day for me and you!

poems.title: The Big Grey Elephant
lines: The big grey elephant walks so slow,
swinging his trunk, to and fro.
He sprays some water, splash, splash, splash,
then takes a nap, and snores! Crash!

poems.title: Butterfly, Butterfly
lines: Butterfly, butterfly, where do you go?
Up to the flowers, high and low.
Orange and purple, yellow and blue,
flutter by, butterfly, I see you!

poems.title: Ten Little Fingers
lines: I have ten fingers, one, two, three,
four, five on one hand, look and see!
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten on the other,
one hand helps the other, like a brother!

poems.title: Choo Choo Train
lines: Choo choo, choo choo, here comes the train,
over the bridge and down the lane.
Chugging along, it never stops,
until it reaches the station. Hop!

poems.title: Fluffy Clouds
lines: Fluffy clouds up in the sky,
like cotton candy, floating by.
One looks like a bunny, one like a shoe,
what shape of cloud can you see too?

poems.title: In My Garden
lines: In my garden, seeds are sleeping,
tiny green shoots are slowly peeping.
A little water, a little sun,
and flowers bloom for everyone!

poems.title: My Red Kite
lines: My red kite goes up so high,
dancing, dancing in the sky.
I hold the string, I run and play,
the wind helps it fly away, away!

poems.title: Friends Together
lines: We share our toys, we take our turn,
we help each other, we laugh, we learn.
When a friend is sad, we hold their hand,
being kind is super grand!

poems.title: Counting Stars
lines: One little star, and then two more,
three, four, five, and I count some more.
Six, seven, eight, nine, shining bright,
ten little stars say good night!

poems.title: Healthy Tummy
lines: Carrots crunch and apples too,
dal and rice are good for you.
Drink your water, eat your greens,
you'll grow strong, like a machine!
